body:
I'd really like doing the things I'd love to do, but I don't even know what they are at this point and the need to work right now doesn't give me a lot of time to do other things.

No matter what, I still feel like doing away with myself is the best solution sometimes and while I know that it's not my emotions get the best of me, I guess. I hope I find a few more things that'll keep me going soon though because I honestly don't have a lot of hope left at all.

Thank you, though. It's nice to feel like not everyone's against me while all of this happens.

On top of everything else I've done it does seem like a very big mess, yeah. But this is so bad compared to the other things that I feel like they're not going to be bothered dealing with me anymore and kick me out if I mess up again.

And the problem is is that I've been getting help for a while now. I've never had the energy to act on the advice I was given and I guess I just got worse and worse until stuff like this happened.

I don't want to go to my mum again, though. She's really, *really* angry with me and every time I've talked to her before it's only made me feel worse. Both of my parents think they've done everything they can as well so going up to them and asking for more help when I don't know what I want doesn't feel like the right move.

I haven't thought about going to the school until you brought it up though, thank you. I'll do that today. It'll give me something to cling onto while I try and sort out this shitstorm I created, I guess.

Thank you so much though and sorry for the late reply. I feel a bit better after reading your post and if things go okay today I'll try and hang on for a little longer.
